title: 2 fishing vessels held in Tayabas Bay amid 'tamban' closed season

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) 4A, through its Fisheries Protection and Law Enforcement Group (FPLEG), apprehended two commercial fishing vessels in Tayabas Bay in Quezon province, on Saturday and Sunday (Nov. 14 and 15) for allegedly violating the closed fishing season. In a report, Allan Castillo, chief of BFAR IV-A’s FPLEG, said patrollers intercepted F/V GENICES 1, a 9.44-gross-ton fishing vessel, at around 3:49 a.m. on Saturday while it was allegedly fishing using a ring net, locally known as “taksay,” within the municipal waters of Unisan.
